Do re-simulated draws reproduce the data?

The data-space ranks judge the flow's draws through the simulator: each draw's overlap with the data, its own SNR and its log-likelihood, ranked against the truth's. They see errors that leave every 1-D marginal exact. Marginal ranks are in calibration, the tests' measured power in test-power.

Which tests reject which defect?

Ranks of the truth among the draws, by SNR stratum

Each panel is one stratum (the draws' median SNR, a function of the data alone). Top: the ECDF of the ranks minus the diagonal, inside the simultaneous 95% band of uniform ranks; a curve leaving the band rejects. Below: the rank histogram in 16 bins, dashed at the uniform expectation. p is the repo's γ test.

The distributions behind the ranks

Truth against the median of the 127 draws, for the first 300 injections of the setting, all 4 slots where per-slot (dashed: equal). Axes are logarithmic for SNR and symmetric-log for the signed overlap and the log-likelihood. A posterior that reproduces the data scatters about the diagonal; one far from the data sits below it. The own-SNR panel is also snr_hat against the true SNR, since snr_hat is the draws' median own SNR.

What this means

  • No run yet. The page holds the mock ladder only (src at 8310cb3, 2026-10-30). Run rows drop in once a run has an eval of the current layout; the 2026-10-24 dusty-otter-narrow-XS files stay in data/ but are not shown.
  • Every eval source is faint (the mocks ran with visible_snr = 0, catalogue windows; snr_hat at most 2.6), so all injections are in the 0–15 stratum and the other strata are empty. The data-space tests are read at sub-threshold SNR; rerun with visible_snr on.
  • Only the data-space ranks catch prior. The identity flow passes own SNR (p = 0.76 narrow, 0.57 full), TARP, average rank and band depth, and is rejected by the joint log-likelihood rank (p = 0.001 narrow, < 0.001 full) and by the overlap rank (p = 0.003 narrow, 0.007 full).
  • Width and shift defects are not clean here. wide, narrow and biased all reject own SNR and the joint log-likelihood rank (p < 0.001), but overlap passes wide (p = 0.09 narrow, 0.10 full) and biased (0.21, 0.15), and narrow on the full band (0.18).
  • fisher is not a null for these tests. It rejects own SNR and the joint log-likelihood rank in both bands (p < 0.001); overlap rejects narrow (0.003) and passes full (0.088). phases-prior and loud-floor read like it (phases-prior overlap on the full band rejects, p = 0.034; loud-floor equals it: no source reaches its SNR 18.4 cap). Compare a mock's p to fisher's, not to 0.05.
